comparison.objective: Set a relief block safely ahead of a saw blade, then position a board against it and the miter gauge.
comparison.physical_skill: Performs interdependent two-arm fixture and workpiece placement while keeping a hazard zone clear.
comparison.success_condition: Relief-block location, board contact/alignment, and avoidance of a trapped-offcut configuration determine success.
comparison.reason: This is safety-constrained saw setup, not unlocking, rotating, relocking, and cycle-testing an adjustable component. The record body does not enumerate all tolerances, but its mechanism and outcome are unrelated.
